title: Axolotl of Undying - Axolotl Totem
description: Replaces the totem with a kawaii axolotl :3
body:
## Replaces the Totem of Undying with a vanilla-style 3D axolotl.

#

### Before

![Ahora son totems en el suelo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2acdbc630abdb5ccaf8052b510d340de799c619b.jpeg)

### After

![Varios ajolotes en el suelos y enmarcados](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/367cd04e26f89d20f1c30a27668032ff630d5971.jpeg)

#

You can change the axolotl variant using the command:


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

`/give @s minecraft:totem_of_undying[custom_model_data={floats:[1]}]`


Replace `1` with another number to select a different axolotl variant

This may vary depending on the version. If you are using Minecraft 1.21.1–1.21.3, you will need to use this command:

`/give @s minecraft:totem_of_undying[CustomModelData=1]`


**Please note that administrator commands are required to obtain specific variants ...**

</details>

#

Baby axolotl variants for Minecraft 1.26.1+ and broader version compatibility are planned for future updates.
